title: Combination Sum III
description:
Find all valid combinations of `k` numbers that sum up to `n` such that the following conditions are satisfied:

- Only numbers 1 through 9 are used.
- Each number is used **at most once**.

Return all possible valid combinations in **any order**.

tests.explanation: Only one combination of 3 numbers summing to 7.
Three combinations of 3 numbers summing to 9.
